channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Nikolas defende Gaspar e diz que vice fortalece chapa de Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) defended Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) ticket, stating he strengthens the ticket. Nikolas highlighted Gaspar's work in public security and the INSS CPI during a press briefing in the Chamber last Wednesday, the 12th.

item.title: Edmundo declara R$ 16 milhões em bens à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Former footballer Edmundo, a federal deputy candidate for the PSDB, declared R$16 million in assets to the Electoral Court. Of this total, R$3.85 million is invested in 147,300 Petrobras shares. His campaign slogan focuses on acting in Brasília to defend Vasco da Gama, the club he won championships with.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda restabelecer filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao PL e determina investigação
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques ordered the immediate reinstatement of Flávio Bolsonaro’s affiliation with the Liberal Party (PL) and the removal of his irregular affiliation with the Mission Party. He also mandated the release of the system for the PL’s candidacy registration, due by August 15 at 7 PM, and directed the Federal Police to open an investigation into the fraudulent affiliation, which the TSE attributes to misuse of credentials, not a system hack.

item.title: Nunes Marques cancela filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão e mantém senador no PL
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques annulled the unauthorized affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro with the Mission party and restored his registration with the PL. The Mission affiliation had blocked his 2022 presidential candidacy registration. The minister also ordered the preservation of system access logs and referred the case to the Federal Police for investigation into potential electoral fraud.

item.title: Com presença de Lula, Ministério do Trabalho faz evento para anunciar saldo de empregos gerados no mandato do petista
item.description: The Ministry of Labor announced that 10.1 million jobs were created between January 2023 and June 2026 during Lula’s third term, surpassing the 8 million figure cited in his own government program. The event, attended by President Lula, marked the launch of bimonthly RAIS data releases, previously annual. The figures were released three days before the official start of the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: TSE condena vereador que xingou colega de “vagabunda” e “escrota”
item.description: The TSE unanimously convicted councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Zezinho do Caminhão) for gender-based political violence against councilwoman Priscila Pitta, imposing a one-year prison sentence replaced by community service, suspension of political rights, and eight years of ineligibility. The ruling confirms that terms like 'slut' and 'whore' constitute gender discrimination aimed at hindering the full exercise of a female mandate.

item.title: Após disputa com Tarcísio, Fazenda autoriza crédito de R$ 5,45 bilhões
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' government secured approval from the Ministry of Finance for a R$ 5.45 billion loan from Banco do Brasil to fund infrastructure and urban mobility projects in São Paulo. The authorization followed political tensions with the federal government and was signed by Finance Minister Dario Durigan. The funds aim to advance key development initiatives in the state.

item.title: Endereço atribuído a Flávio Bolsonaro na filiação ao Missão foi 'Rua dos Bandidos' e 'Bairro dos Milicianos'
item.description: A document from the Missão party shows that Flávio Bolsonaro was fraudulently affiliated with the party using a fictitious address ('Rua Dos Bandidos, n° 666, Bairro Miliciano') by an unidentified third party who misused the party’s own credentials. Flávio’s campaign claims this blocks his PL presidential candidacy registration, while Missão alleges to have proof someone accessed his email and confirmed the affiliation. The TSE ruled out a hacker attack, stating the affiliation resulted from improper use of the party’s tools by someone with legitimate access to its credentials.

item.title: TSE decide que pesquisas devem indicar bairro, e não setor censitário do IBGE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ruled 4-3 that electoral research institutes must disclose the neighborhood, not the IBGE census sector, where interviews were conducted, prioritizing transparency over technical precision for voter understanding. The decision overturned a fine imposed by the Piauí Regional Electoral Court on Quaest for failing to disclose neighborhoods in a 2024 poll, setting future standards for electoral research in Brazil.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda restabelecer filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao PL após troca por Missão
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques ordered the immediate reinstatement of Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the PL party after he claimed his transfer to the Mission party was made without his authorization. The change had been recorded in the Electoral Justice system, sparking controversy. The ruling aims to correct what is alleged to be an unauthorized action.

item.title: TSE cassa ex-vereador por violência de gênero após humilhar colega em comissão
item.description: The TSE unanimously removed former Nova Friburgo councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Zezinho do Caminhão) from office for political gender violence, after he humiliated a female colleague in a committee meeting. The ruling was based on evidence of discriminatory and hostile conduct.

item.title: EUA negam plano de Rubio para impedir reeleição de Lula
item.description: The U.S. State Department denied having any plan to prevent President Lula’s potential re-election, stating it will respect any democratically elected government in Brazil. The statement came after a report suggested Lula’s team believed Secretary of State Marco Rubio was involved in such efforts. The U.S. emphasized its commitment to respecting Brazilian sovereignty and electoral processes.

item.title: Nunes Marques determina que Flávio Bolsonaro volte ao PL e abre investigação
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the immediate return of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the Liberal Party (PL), nullifying his affiliation with Partido Missão, ruling that the transfer did not reflect his will. He also mandated a Federal Police investigation into the alleged unauthorized filiation and opened the Candex system for Bolsonaro’s candidacy registration, with the deadline set for Saturday, the 15th.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Missão: entenda como funciona a filiação aos partidos no TSE e como teria ocorrido a fraude
item.description: The TSE found that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's party affiliation change to Missão was made improperly using credentials of a Missão party representative, constituting improper access use, not system intrusion. The incident temporarily blocked his presidential candidacy registration with PL due to dual affiliation prohibition, but the TSE ordered immediate reinstatement of his PL affiliation and allowed candidacy registration.

item.title: Nunes Marques acolhe petição de Flávio Bolsonaro, que está de volta ao PL
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques granted a petition from Flávio Bolsonaro’s lawyers to restore his membership in the Liberal Party (PL), ending the attempt to affiliate him with Renan Santos’ Missão party. The ruling confirms Flávio Bolsonaro’s return to the PL, his father’s party, following an internal dispute over his affiliation. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: PF vai abrir inquérito para apurar filiação indevida de Flávio Bolsonaro ao partido Missão
item.description: The Federal Police will open an investigation into the improper affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to the Mission party, which occurred in the early hours of August 12-13, nullifying his PL affiliation and blocking his presidential candidacy registration with the TSE. The PL has requested deregistration and preservation of electronic logs to identify perpetrators, while the Mission party claims to be a victim of fraud and is cooperating with authorities.

item.title: Nunes Marques restabelece filiação de Flávio ao PL e determina exclusão do vínculo com o Missão
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques restored Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the PL and ordered the removal of the fraudulent link to the Missão Party, enabling immediate registration of his presidential candidacy. The TSE concluded the Missão affiliation stemmed from improper use of credentials, not hacking, and requested a PF investigation.

item.title: Nunes Marques restabelece filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao PL
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques ordered the immediate reinstatement of Flávio Bolsonaro's party affiliation with the Liberal Party (PL), retroactive to November 30, 2021, nullifying the improper link with the Mission. The ruling validates his partisan status since his original enrollment.

item.title: Nunes Marques restabelece filiação de Flávio ao PL e libera registro de candidatura
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques restored Flávio Bolsonaro's PL affiliation and cleared the way for his presidential candidacy after an unauthorized system change incorrectly linked him to the Missão party. The ruling ensures he can run as a PL candidate, reversing the block caused by an unsanctioned entry in the FILIA system.

item.title: TSE condena vereador por violência política contra colega mulher em Nova Friburgo (RJ)
item.description: The TSE unanimously convicted councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Solidariedade) of gender-based political violence against councilwoman Priscila Teixeira Pitta Muniz (PT) in Nova Friburgo (RJ), sentencing him to one year in prison (replaced by community service), suspending his political rights, and declaring him ineligible. The court rejected the parliamentary immunity argument used by the TRE-RJ, stating that the offenses committed inside the Municipal Chamber constituted a crime under Article 326-B of the Electoral Code, with the intent to hinder the victim’s mandate due to her gender.

item.title: Disputa do PT após perda de cadeira na Câmara pode travar distribuição de Fundo Eleitoral pelo TSE
item.description: The PT has asked the TSE to recalculate the Electoral Fund after losing a congressional seat due to vote recount in Alagoas, which could delay the distribution of 48% of the fund to all parties. Minister Nunes Marques, the case’s rapporteur, voted to reject the PT’s request, but the trial was suspended by a request for review from Minister Estela Aranha. Until a decision is made, no party will receive this portion of the fund, even though the total is R$4.9 billion and the PT currently stands to receive about R$615.4 million under existing calculations.

item.title: Irmã de Hugo Motta omite R$ 1 milhão em cotas de empresas em declaração ao TSE
item.description: Olívia Motta, a candidate for state deputy and sister of Chamber President Hugo Motta, omitted R$1.05 million in shares from seven companies in her asset declaration to the TSE, reporting only R$10,000 in business participation. After being contacted by Estadão, the Republicans party treasurer acknowledged the error and said he had submitted the correction to the TRE-PB. Her declared assets were R$877,200, but the omitted amount exceeds 20.3% of that total, including a vehicle valued at R$192,500, an ultrasound machine at R$94,500, and R$536,000 in cash.

item.title: O verdadeiro patrimônio de Val Marchiori após erro em declaração eleitoral
item.description: Val Marchiori, a Republican candidate for federal deputy in São Paulo, declared assets of R$ 1.3 million to the Electoral Justice after correcting an initial error that reported R$ 49 million. The error stemmed from an extra digit in the valuation of a property, later corrected by the TSE. Over 60% of her declared assets consist of jewelry, artworks, and collectible items.

item.title: Fachin presta solidariedade a Dino, diz respeitar imprensa e promete colaborar com investigações
item.description: STF President Luiz Edson Fachin expressed solidarity with Minister Flávio Dino and stated the court will cooperate with investigations into alleged persecution against Dino in Maranhão. He also emphasized respect for press freedom, balancing institutional support with democratic principles.

item.title: Haddad contesta apuração preliminar da gestão Tarcísio sobre divergências em versão de motorista
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for Governor of São Paulo, contested the preliminary investigation by the Tarcísio de Freitas government regarding discrepancies in a driver's account allegedly followed by a Military Police vehicle on Tuesday (11). Haddad stated that the government's version is partial and does not reflect the actual facts. The statement was made on Thursday (13), amid rising political tension between the two candidates.

item.title: Nunes Marques vota contra aumento do fundo eleitoral do PT
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques voted against increasing the electoral fund requested by the PT for the 2026 elections, rejecting the action that sought to recalculate the distribution of resources. The judgment was suspended after his vote due to a request for vista, allowing more time for analysis.

item.title: TSE e Kwai lançam página com orientações oficiais para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE and Kwai launched the 'Everything About the 2026 Elections' page to provide official guidance from the Electoral Justice, starting with content on temporary voting section transfer and absentee voting. The initiative includes explanatory videos on Kwai and will expand to cover topics such as e-Title, electronic voting machine security, biometrics, and AI use in campaigns, tracking the electoral process up to the first and second rounds on October 4 and 25, 2026.

item.title: Nunes Marques deve cancelar ainda hoje filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro no Missão
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques is expected to remove Flávio Bolsonaro from the Mission Party and restore his affiliation with the PL on Thursday (14), enabling him to register his presidential candidacy for the 2026 elections. The decision follows challenges to the validity of his prior party affiliation and aims to secure his electoral eligibility. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Lula grava programa eleitoral com João Campos para Pernambuco
item.description: President Lula recorded the electoral program for João Campos, the PSB candidate for Governor of Pernambuco, ending controversy over the use of two political slates in the state. The recording reinforces Lula's support for Campos, who is running against Governor Raquel Lyra of the PSD. The event took place this Friday (14).

item.title: Campanha de Flávio rebate nota do Missão sobre filiação: 'Molecagem'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign criticized the Missão party's note regarding his alleged fraudulent affiliation, calling it 'nonsense' and stating it fails to clarify what occurred. The campaign attempted to register his candidacy with the TSE this morning but was blocked because he was affiliated with Missão yesterday, creating a legal impediment.

item.title: Haddad cobra segurança e critica gestão Tarcísio após ação da PM
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, said he needs to feel safe during the electoral process after reporting a suspicious police approach near his home. He also criticized the security management of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), linking the incident to the state's current public safety policies.

item.title: TSE: Kássio enviou representação ao MP para providências sobre filiação de Flávio ao Missão
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kássio Nunes Marques, submitted a representation to the Electoral General Prosecutor's Office (PGE) requesting action regarding the affiliation of pre-candidate Flávio Dino to the Mission party. The move aims to clarify whether there are any irregularities in the politician's party membership, in accordance with electoral law.

item.title: “A chance de ser uma malandragem é enorme”, diz Renan sobre filiação de Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos, a candidate from the Missão party, stated that the party can prove someone accessed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's official email and confirmed his affiliation with the party, along with access to the militia app. He suggested the situation amounts to 'skullduggery' due to the high likelihood of irregularity.

item.title: Prazo para mudar de partido acabou em abril; entenda condições de elegibilidade
item.description: The deadline to change parties for the 2026 general elections ended on April 4, a requirement for eligibility for all offices. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) had his presidential candidacy blocked due to appearing affiliated with the Missão party in Electoral Justice records, despite being the PL's nominee. The TSE denied it was a hacker attack, stating the registration resulted from improper use of credentials by someone affiliated with the Missão party.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio pede que PF investigue fraude em sistema do TSE
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed an urgent request with the TSE for the Federal Police to investigate an alleged fraud in the party affiliation system, claiming he was wrongfully linked to the Mission Party without his consent days before the presidential candidacy registration deadline. The change occurred between August 12 and 13, when the FILIA system showed his disaffiliation from the PL due to a 'more recent affiliation' with the Mission Party, which the defense claims was intended to block his candidacy registration. The defense seeks immediate restoration of his PL affiliation, removal of the invalid Mission Party affiliation, access to the Candex system for candidacy registration, and preservation of digital evidence.

item.title: Renan diz que quem filiou Flávio Bolsonaro acessou conta de e-mail do senador para confirmação; cadastro informa 'Rua dos Bandidos' como endereço do candidato do PL
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, claimed that an unauthorized access to Flávio Bolsonaro's email was used to fraudulently enroll the senator in the party, citing internal documents showing a fictitious address ('Rua dos Bandidos'). Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign denies the enrollment and states that the TSE cannot register his candidacy due to this inconsistency, while the Missão party asserts that Bolsonaro's office was aware of the incident and failed to act to correct it.

item.title: TRE manda Facebook retirar do ar posts impulsionados contra Haddad
item.description: The TRE-SP ordered Facebook to take down three boosted posts from a fake profile that falsely claimed Fernando Haddad (PT) would increase taxes. The posts, labeled as 'dark posts', were suspended and the profile 'Plantão Brasil 24h' was removed. The ruling aims to ensure transparency and electoral oversight in São Paulo.

item.title: Plano de Flávio vai propor programa de pontuação para empreendedoras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s government plan proposes the 'Ganha, Ganha' program, a points-based system for women entrepreneurs, where completing training courses, working regularly, saving, and paying bills on time earn points redeemable for financial benefits such as lower interest rates, cashback, and easier credit access. The initiative aims to recognize the often-overlooked efforts of women excluded from formal finance and promote economic independence, with voluntary participation and backing from public banks including Caixa, Banco da Amazônia, and Banco do Nordeste.

item.title: Filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão: veja o que já se sabe
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was unable to register his presidential candidacy after appearing improperly affiliated with the Mission Party in Electoral Justice systems. The TSE ruled out hacking, citing misuse of credentials by someone affiliated with the Mission Party, while the PL filed a disaffiliation request currently under review. The final deadline for candidate registration is Saturday, March 15, at 7 p.m.

item.title: Fila, maquiagem e vídeos curtos: os bastidores das gravações com Lula
item.description: President Lula recorded short videos with over 30 allied candidates at his campaign headquarters in Brasília, with makeup support and quick productions for TV, radio and social media. Behind-the-scenes details included queues, makeup touch-ups and Lula’s upbeat demeanor, helping shy candidates feel comfortable. Some, like Patrus Ananias (MG), had longer sessions and praised the president’s leniency.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio aparece no Missão como morador da “Rua dos Bandidos”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's registration with the Missão party featured an unusual address: "Rua dos Bandidos" in the "Bairro Miliciano", with number 666 and a non-existent ZIP code. While his party affiliation was already seen as unconventional, the address detail sparked controversy and mockery on social media. The story was reported by Crusoé and picked up by O Antagonista.

item.title: Em tom de chacota, cadastro falso diz que Flávio Bolsonaro mora na "Rua dos Bandidos"
item.description: A false registration made in the name of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used mocking data, assigning him the address 'Rua dos Bandidos', number 666, in the 'Miliciano Neighborhood', Rio de Janeiro, and affiliating him with the Mission Party. The article, exclusive to subscribers, emphasizes the humorous and provocative nature of the fake registration, with no confirmation of authenticity or involvement by the senator.

item.title: Kassab sobre Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Por que não defendeu as vacinas na pandemia?’
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for not defending vaccines during the pandemic, despite having influence as the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Kassab said the Bolsonaro family, while in power, hindered vaccination efforts and that public officials must act when they hold authority. He emphasized that the PSD supports science and vaccines, in contrast to recent Bolsonarist denialism.

item.title: A fortuna declarada por Eduardo Cunha em seu retorno às urnas
item.description: Eduardo Cunha, former Chamber president removed from office during Operation Car Wash, is running again in the 2026 elections as a federal deputy candidate for Minas Gerais, declaring R$ 14.1 million in assets — nearly identical to his 2022 declaration. His wealth is largely tied to a R$ 12.5 million judicial deposit at Caixa Economica, plus real estate, business stakes, and a car. His candidacy is being challenged in electoral court over alleged ineligibility due to an administrative misconduct conviction, while he is also under STF investigation for allegedly influencing parliamentary amendments despite holding no mandate.

item.title: PL não consegue registrar Flávio como candidato após fraude alterar filiação do senador para partido Missão, afirma campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign claims it was unable to register his presidential candidacy due to a fraud that altered his party affiliation in the Electoral Justice system to the Mission party, created last year. Campaign lawyer Maria Claudia Bucchianeri suspects improper password use or malicious action, stating the senator lacks regular affiliation, blocking registration before the Saturday 7 p.m. deadline. The PL has appealed to the TSE to correct the affiliation and investigate, while the court said the investigation is underway and ruled out system hacking.

item.title: Pedido de vista interrompe julgamento do TSE sobre cálculo do Fundo Eleitoral para o PT
item.description: Minister Estela Aranha requested a pause (vista), halting the TSE's judgment on the PT's petition to recalculate the Electoral Fund distribution for the 2026 elections. The PT claims an error in counting its congressional caucus — 68 instead of the 69 elected in 2022 — which would affect its share of campaign funds. Relator Kassio Nunes Marques voted against the petition, warning that the decision could impact all parties and that no funds will be distributed until the ruling is finalized.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aciona TSE e pede medida de urgência para voltar ao PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed an urgent request with the TSE to reverse his affiliation with the Missão party and return to the PL, claiming the change was made improperly by a third party using the party's credentials. The petition was filed two days before the candidacy registration deadline and also requests a PF investigation into alleged fraud. The TSE denies hacking, stating the change resulted from unauthorized use of the party's login credentials.

item.title: 'Só sabem jogar sujo', diz Flávio Bolsonaro após ser filiado ao Missão; PL aponta fraude, e TSE manda investigar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was improperly affiliated with the Missão party, blocking his presidential candidacy registration under the PL coalition. The TSE ruled out hacking, citing misuse of Missão’s credentials, and ordered a judicial investigation and referral to the PGE. Bolsonaro accused opponents of fraud, declaring he will not back down.

item.title: TSE diz que troca de filiação de Flávio foi feita por pessoa com uso de credenciais do Missão; Nunes Marques manda investigar caso
item.description: The TSE confirmed that Flávio Bolsonaro's party affiliation change to Missão was made by an authorized person using the party's credentials, not through hacking, and ordered an investigation by the PGE and Judicial Police. The incident temporarily blocked his PL presidential candidacy due to dual affiliation rules. The PL has requested the affiliation be annulled, and the request is under review by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: TSE nega ataque hacker na filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão e abre inquérito para investigar
item.description: The TSE denied that the fraudulent affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro with the Mission party resulted from a hacker attack, stating it was carried out by someone with the party’s credentials. The TSE president ordered a judicial police investigation and forwarded a representation to the PGE to address the improper use of the affiliation system. The PL has already filed a request to disaffiliate Bolsonaro from the party.
